scope: Official Shopify Symmetry:Amara preset listing View demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility tree. Home, Rings collection, Diamond Engagement Ring PDP and empty cart inspected; no shopper control, screenshot, viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Symmetry:Amara listing View demo opened symmetry-amara.myshopify.com.

claims.observed: Home organizes jewelry through category collections, material/care themes and gifting/editorial content; 32-item Rings collection shows Filter, Featured sort, GBP prices, ratings and sold-out states.
claims.risk: No filter or sort behavior tested; reviews, stock and seller content are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Use product-type and occasion paths to structure jewelry discovery, and validate inventory and review data.

claims.observed: Engagement-ring PDP presents metal finish and ring size choices with size guidance and service propositions; empty cart provides Start Shopping and a You Might Love These carousel.
claims.risk: No variants or cart actions tested; British-made, ethical-material, fit and shipping claims are not independently confirmed.
claims.vsn_guard: Make sizing and metal choices clear and substantiate materials and production claims; keep cart recommendations relevant.
